description: A searchable grid of the app's own icons, with a no icon choice, driven fully from the keyboard. The choice is stored as a permanent icon id in the same document as the thing it names, so it exports, shares and follows you to another computer. There is no color choice: an icon always wears its parent's color, under every theme. Group headings in the agents drawer use it now (the group's menu, icon); wrapper groups, widgets and tabs adopt it as they ship.
examples: Mark a research group with a flask so it stands out when collapsed.
Give a launch profile group a bolt icon so its sessions are easy to tell apart.
how_to: Type in the filter field to narrow the icons by name or meaning.
Click an icon, or press the down arrow to enter the grid, move with the arrow keys and press enter.
Choose no icon, the first cell, to remove one.
name: Icon picker
summary: One picker for choosing an icon for something you named; the icon takes the color of whatever it sits in.
where: The style guide's icons section shows it live (/static/style-guide.html#icons-picker).
In the app it opens from the surfaces that adopt it: group headings, launch profiles, widgets and tabs.
media_exempt: screenshots and captures are not part of the open source export
